sources.snippet: GGUF Loader v2.2.0 is the stable, universal model loader. You pick any GGUF model that fits your PC's resources — from small 3B models on modest machines to large 70B+ models on high-end rigs. The app detects your hardware (RAM, VRAM, CPU/GPU) and recommends models that work for you.
